name: M3_PDS010MI_Get
description: Retrieve detailed information for a single work center within a specific facility. The call returns the full master data for that work center, including identity and description, capacity and planning parameters, scheduling and load settings, quality and reporting options, and warehouse/location defaults. Use it to read how a work center is configured before performing capacity calculations, planning, or updates elsewhere in M3.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility where the work center to be displayed is defined.

inputParameters.name: PLGR
inputParameters.description: Work center to be displayed within the specified facility.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility where the retrieved work center is defined.

outputParameters.name: PLGR
outputParameters.description: Identifier of the retrieved work center.

outputParameters.name: PLNM
outputParameters.description: Name of the work center as shown in lists and inquiries.

outputParameters.name: PLGT
outputParameters.description: Work center type used to group this work center and drive facility-specific selection in maintenance processes.

outputParameters.name: PLTP
outputParameters.description: Resource type of this work center, such as standard work center, subcontractor, rough-cut resource, SWB resource, or maintenance.

outputParameters.name: OPDS
outputParameters.description: Default operation description proposed when creating operations for this work center.

outputParameters.name: PITI
outputParameters.description: Standard run time used for operations in this work center when calculating load and lead time.

outputParameters.name: SETI
outputParameters.description: Standard setup time used for operations in this work center when calculating load and lead time.

outputParameters.name: FXTI
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the entered run time applies as a fixed total time regardless of produced quantity at this work center.

outputParameters.name: PRNP
outputParameters.description: Planned number of workers normally used during run time for operations in this work center.

outputParameters.name: IIWC
outputParameters.description: Superior work center that this work center belongs to for rough-cut capacity planning and reporting.

outputParameters.name: DEPT
outputParameters.description: Department to which this work center belongs for capacity reporting and accounting.

outputParameters.name: REAR
outputParameters.description: Planning area that groups this work center for planning and load total calculations.

outputParameters.name: PCAP
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the work center’s capacity is planned in machine hours or man-hours.

outputParameters.name: WCRE
outputParameters.description: User responsible for maintaining information and planning for this work center.

outputParameters.name: AVEF
outputParameters.description: Utilization rate used to adjust the work center’s rated capacity to expected net capacity.

outputParameters.name: WCNP
outputParameters.description: Number of persons normally working in this work center used to calculate man-hour capacity.

outputParameters.name: WCNM
outputParameters.description: Number of machines normally available in this work center used to calculate machine capacity.

outputParameters.name: PTUN
outputParameters.description: Time unit of measure used when entering setup, run, and other times for this work center.

outputParameters.name: PIDW
outputParameters.description: Default panel identity used for the work order work center schedule for this work center.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Default warehouse associated with this work center for material issues and receipts.

outputParameters.name: WHSL
outputParameters.description: Default warehouse location associated with this work center for material issues and receipts.

outputParameters.name: TWSL
outputParameters.description: Default destination location used for stock movements to or from this work center.

outputParameters.name: AUIN
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether receipt transactions are created automatically when the last operation is reported at this work center.

outputParameters.name: CRTR
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether operations at this work center are treated as critical and require special attention in planning.

outputParameters.name: COCE
outputParameters.description: Cost center to which costs and revenues for this work center are posted.

outputParameters.name: APLC
outputParameters.description: Work zone used to group this work center with other resources in the same geographical area.

outputParameters.name: MAHD
outputParameters.description: Maximum number of working hours per day planned for this work center.
